question: What analogy illustrates stable non-conceptual awareness of a single object?
premises: One may see a red object in front with non-conceptual awareness.
The awareness remains unified despite various aspects of the object.
inference: Non-conceptual awareness can grasp a single object as an indivisible whole through its varied aspects.
plain_english: Just as, seeing something red in front with non-conceptual awareness, one remains firmly established in the indivisible awareness of a single pot through its various aspects...
